Warwick doctoral funding for 2027

The previous Chancellor’s International link now directs to Warwick’s combined 2027 postgraduate research scholarship competition. The original listing slug is retained; use the current university instructions for the award streams.

Funding

The competition includes full UK or international academic fees and a tax-free maintenance stipend. Faculty and Interdisciplinary Chancellor’s streams advertise 3.5 years at the applicable UKRI rate and a GBP 5,000 research training and support grant. The previous GBP 10,000 annual maintenance figure has been removed.

Eligibility and deadlines

Check the chosen stream and eligible research course. Course applications close on 7 December 2026, scholarships on 10 December and references on 21 December; all are at 16:59 GMT. Some streams are open to any nationality and fee status, but individual additional conditions apply.

Current official competition, eligibility and application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT; course application 7 December; references 21 December. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
